_comment: Merge this Stop-hook configuration into your .claude/settings.local.json
(or .claude/settings.json) to enable in-session Ralph for the solo variant.
Easiest way to install: run /ralph-trio:install-stop-hook from inside Claude Code,
which merges this snippet idempotently. Manual install instructions below.
Before starting a Claude Code session, set these env vars in the shell:
export RALPH_VARIANT=solo            # only solo is supported via hook
export AGENT_TEAM=ralph-session      # optional, for log isolation
Then start `claude` and give it any opening message (e.g. 'begin'). The hook
will block each Stop event and re-inject PROMPT.md until the completion
marker appears in fix_plan.md, or RALPH_MAX_ITER iterations have run.
Trio and debate variants stay on bash drivers — they orchestrate multiple
external CLIs (Codex, Antigravity) which the in-session hook cannot launch cleanly.
stop-hook.sh is resolved from PATH while the ralph-trio plugin is active.
